snippet.title: Steel Soul Shaper | Official Playtest Trailer | Limited time playtest out now!
snippet.description:
A narrative-driven simulation where you play a highly skilled cyberware surgeon running a secret back-alley clinic in a cyberpunk city. As you modify your clients' bodies, you'll hear their stories, uncover their secrets, and quietly shape the course of destiny in this concrete jungle.

🛰️ Playtest Now Live!
📅 17 Mar onwards
🎮 Join the playtest on Steam:
👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/4239670
